# doodle-jump (gemini-cli)

**Path:** `games/doodle-jump_gemini-cli.html`
**Generated by:** Gemini CLI
**Size:** ~923 lines (single file) — the leanest of the three variants

## What it is

A Doodle Jump clone — fully self-contained HTML file (HTML + inline CSS + inline `<script>`). Open in any browser; no build, no dependencies.

## Style / approach

- Off-white grid-paper background (`#f3f1e9` with a 20px linear-gradient grid) — sketchpad feel.
- Canvas constrained to `max-width: 500px` and centered (mobile-first portrait framing).
- Screens (`.screen`) are toggled via `display: none/flex` rather than overlay positioning.
- Comic Sans typography; rounded `border-radius: 20px` cards.
- Smallest file of the three — minimal styling, leaves more room for raw mechanics.

## How to run

```bash
open games/doodle-jump_gemini-cli.html
```

## When to use as reference

The simplest/most compact implementation — good baseline for comparing how the three AI tools structured the same problem.
